name: Loraine Almiren
source:
A well-known and highly popular prostitute at the brothel. Madame Natal presents her as an Aen'Thariel.

[spoiler]In the past, he was a man — the young heir of an old and wealthy family. One day, he fell in love with a simple girl named Katria, who persuaded him to abandon everything and flee with her, only to betray him. His father imprisoned him in a dungeon and, through the work of an alchemist, altered his body to be more feminine. He then sold him to a house of pleasure in another city, hoping he would perish there. She seeks [url=/c166841]Rhiannon[/url]'s help to take revenge on her father and her former fiancée.[/spoiler]

[In-Game Description]
